data.text: search the web and explain anthropics web search api in three short sentences with sources

Here's a concise explanation of Anthropic's Web Search API in three sentences:

1. Anthropic introduced web search on its API as a new tool that gives Claude access to current information from across the web, enabling developers to build Claude-powered applications and agents that deliver up-to-date insights.

2. The feature works by having Claude generate targeted search queries when up-to-date information is needed, analyze the results to extract relevant information, and provide a comprehensive response with citations â€” and in some cases, it can perform iterative searches, refining queries based on previous results for more detailed answers.

3. Web search is available for Claude 3.7 Sonnet, the upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku at $10 per 1,000 searches plus standard token costs.

**Sources:**
- [Anthropic Official Announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/web-search-api)
- [InfoQ â€“ Anthropic Introduces Web Search Functionality](https://www.infoq.com/news/2025/05/anthropic-web-search/)
- [TechCrunch â€“ Anthropic rolls out an API for AI-powered web search](https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/07/anthropic-rolls-out-an-api-for-ai-powered-web-search/)
